closest_results.comparison: R_3(c,c,c)=13c+14 for all c>=0, with repeated variables.
Two assigned shifts only; exact two-color thresholds do not imply the three-color classification.
Three color classes with varying number of summands and no shifts; no implication for different inhomogeneous constants.

conclusion: The diagonal is known. No exact all-nonconstant three-shift classification or the same uniform periodic coloring was located in the recorded sources. This is a scoped finding, without a global priority claim.
scope: Exact three assigned shifts over positive integers; off-diagonal periodic witnesses and diagonal exact value assessed separately.
